data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus/(deficit) run-off deviation of (GBP 8.6) million was experienced in 2016 (a GBP 3.5 million surplus in 2015).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate closed 2015 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 172.629m at 1 January 2016. During 2016 there was adverse prior-year reserve development, reported as a deficit run-off deviation of GBP 8.6m (i.e. a strengthening of reserves), representing approximately 5.0% of the opening gross claims outstanding. The report describes this as a run-off deficit, indicating adverse claims development primarily across prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: surplus/(deficit) run-off deviation of (GBP 8.6) million was experienced in 2016 (a GBP 3.5 million surplus in 2015).
